name: Functional Strength
headline: Build strength for the way you want to live.
summary: Build capacity: practical strength, stability, confidence, movement and durability.
description: Individualized strength and movement training designed to build practical capability for the way you actually live. Whether you’re new to strength training, returning after time away, focused on aging well or building strength for work, family or the outdoors, your training is built around your abilities, goals and life.
metaDescription: Functional strength training in Brighton and Howell, MI, or virtually, built around your abilities, goals and everyday life.
scopeNote: When an injury, surgery, or medical condition affects training, services remain within professional scope and may require clearance or collaboration with your healthcare or rehabilitation providers.

value.heading: How we help
value.lead: Functional strength training at TAB starts with the person, not the workout.
paragraphs: We consider where you are today, what you want your body to be capable of, what gets in the way, and what kind of training realistically fits your life.
Programs are individualized and progressively adapted as strength, confidence, movement quality, and goals change—especially for people who don’t identify as “gym people.”

cards.title: New to strength
cards.body: A supportive start with the fundamentals, at your pace.

cards.title: Returning after time away
cards.body: Rebuild capacity and confidence without starting from zero.

cards.title: Healthy aging
cards.body: Strength, balance, and stability for independence over time.

cards.title: Return to activity
cards.body: Progress back toward the sports and activities you love, when cleared.

cards.title: Strength for real life
cards.body: Capacity for the work, family, recreation and outdoor life you actually have.

cards.title: Balance and confidence
cards.body: Stability, mobility and the confidence to move without second-guessing.

value.transform: Build strength, movement skill and confidence.
value.adapt: Progressively respond to changing loads and demands.
value.balance: Match challenge with recovery and sustainable progression.
value.quote: Build strength that transfers to real life.

steps.title: Assessment
steps.body: We look at your current strength, movement, history, and goals—no judgment, no fitness test theatrics.

steps.title: Your plan
steps.body: A progressive program that may include resistance, functional movement, mobility, stability, balance, and recovery.

steps.title: Progression
steps.body: We adjust as you get stronger and as your goals and life change.

items.a: No. Training starts from where you are today, whether that’s brand new or returning after years away.
Yes. Training can be delivered in person or virtually, with a plan built around your space and equipment.

items.q: What if I have an injury or recent surgery?
items.a: We’ll ask about it during intake and may request clearance from your provider. Training is adapted to what’s appropriate for you.
We’ll recommend a frequency based on your goals and schedule, including what you can do on your own between sessions.
